neighbor_points =: 4 : 0
    'width height' =. x
    'column row' =. y
    result =. 0 2$0x
    for_dy. _1 0 1 do.
        for_dx. _1 0 1 do.
            if. (dx=0)*.dy=0 do.
                continue.
            end.
            nx =. column+dx
            ny =. row+dy
            if. (nx>:0)*.(nx<width)*.(ny>:0)*.ny<height do.
                result =. result,nx,ny
            end.
        end.
    end.
    result
)
directions =: 3 : 0
    'gx gy' =. y
    'height width' =. $gx
    result =. (height,width)$0
    for_row. i.height do.
        for_column. i.width do.
            horizontal =. (<row,column){gx
            vertical =. (<row,column){gy
            ax =. |horizontal
            ay =. |vertical
            if. (29*ay)<:12*ax do.
                angle =. 0
            elseif. (29*ay)>:70*ax do.
                angle =. 90
            elseif. (horizontal*vertical)<0 do.
                angle =. 45
            else.
                angle =. 135
            end.
            result =. angle (<row,column)}result
        end.
    end.
    result
)
suppress =: 4 : 0
    magnitude =. x

    'height width' =. $magnitude
    offsets =. 4 2$_1 0 1 _1 0 _1 _1 _1
    result =. (height,width)$0x
    for_row. 1+i.height-2 do.
        for_column. 1+i.width-2 do.
            angle =. (<row,column){direction

            value =. (<row,column){magnitude

            after =. (<(row-dy),column-dx){magnitude
            if. (value>before)*.value>:after do.
                result =. value (<row,column)}result
            end.

    end.

)
hysteresis =: 4 : 0
    'low high' =. x
    'height width' =. $y
    strong =. y>:high
    weak =. (y>:low)*.y<high
    edges =. strong
    indices =. I.,strong
    queue =. (width|indices),.indices intdiv width
    cursor =. 0
    while. cursor<#queue do.
        point =. cursor{queue
        cursor =. cursor+1
        for_next. (width,height)neighbor_points point do.
            'nx ny' =. next
            position =. <ny,nx
            if. (-.position{edges)*.(position{strong)+.position{weak do.
                edges =. 1 position}edges
                queue =. queue,next
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<edges),(<strong),<weak
)
edge_components =: 3 : 0
    edges =. y
    'height width' =. $edges
    visited =. (height,width)$0
    result =. 0$a:
    for_index. I.,edges do.
        'column row' =. (width|index),index intdiv width
        position =. <row,column
        if. position{visited do.
            continue.
        end.
        visited =. 1 position}visited
        queue =. ,:column,row
        cursor =. 0
        while. cursor<#queue do.
            point =. cursor{queue
            cursor =. cursor+1
            for_next. (width,height)neighbor_points point do.
                'nx ny' =. next
                position =. <ny,nx
                if. (position{edges)*.-.position{visited do.
                    visited =. 1 position}visited
                    queue =. queue,next
                end.
            end.
        end.
        result =. result,<queue
    end.
    result
)

harris_candidates =: 3 : 0
    'gx gy window threshold' =. y
    'height width' =. $gx
    half =. window intdiv 2
    response =. (height,width)$0x
    for_row. i.height do.
        for_column. i.width do.
            xx =. 0x
            yy =. 0x
            xy =. 0x
            for_dy. (-half)+i.1+2*half do.
                for_dx. (-half)+i.1+2*half do.
                    point =. (column+dx),row+dy
                    horizontal =. gx clamped point
                    vertical =. gy clamped point
                    xx =. xx+horizontal*horizontal
                    yy =. yy+vertical*vertical
                    xy =. xy+horizontal*vertical
                end.
            end.
            value =. ((xx*yy)-xy*xy)-((xx+yy)*(xx+yy))intdiv 25
            response =. value (<row,column)}response
        end.
    end.
    candidates =. 0 3$0x
    for_row. i.height do.
        for_column. i.width do.
            value =. (<row,column){response
            if. value<threshold do.
                continue.
            end.
            peak =. 1
            for_dy. _1 0 1 do.
                if. -.peak do.
                    break.
                end.
                for_dx. _1 0 1 do.
                    nx =. column+dx
                    ny =. row+dy
                    if. (nx<0)+.(nx>:width)+.(ny<0)+.ny>:height do.
                        continue.
                    end.
                    if. (dx=0)*.dy=0 do.
                        continue.
                    end.
                    other =. (<ny,nx){response
                    earlier =. (ny<row)+.(ny=row)*.nx<column
                    if. (other>value)+.(other=value)*.earlier do.
                        peak =. 0
                        break.
                    end.
                end.
            end.
            if. peak do.
                candidates =. candidates,column,row,value
            end.
        end.
    end.
    keys =. (-2{"1 candidates),.(1{"1 candidates),.0{"1 candidates
    candidates =. candidates /: keys
    (<response),<candidates
)

circle_points =: 3 : 0
    radius =. y
    a =. radius
    b =. 0x
    error =. 1-radius
    points =. 0 2$0x
    while. a>:b do.
        symmetries =. 8 2$(a,b),(b,a),(-b,a),(-a,b),(-a,-b),(-b,-a),(b,-a),a,-b
        points =. ~.points,symmetries
        b =. b+1
        if. error<0 do.
            error =. error+(2*b)+1
        else.
            a =. a-1
            error =. error+(2*(b-a))+1
        end.
    end.
    points
)
circle_votes =: 3 : 0
    'edges width height low high' =. y
    cells =. ((1+high-low),height,width)$0x
    outlines =. 0$a:
    for_radius. low+i.1+high-low do.
        offsets =. circle_points radius
        outlines =. outlines,<offsets
        radius_index =. radius-low
        for_point. edges do.
            for_offset. offsets do.
                'column row' =. point+offset
                if. (column>:0)*.(column<width)*.(row>:0)*.row<height do.
                    position =. <radius_index,row,column
                    cells =. (1+position{cells)position}cells
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<cells),(<outlines),(<low),<high
)
circle_peaks =: 4 : 0
    minimum =. x
    'cells outlines low high' =. y
    'radius_count height width' =. $cells
    sizes =. #&>outlines
    candidate_count =. 0
    peaks =. 0 5$0x
    for_radius_index. i.radius_count do.
        denominator =. radius_index{sizes
        for_row. i.height do.
            for_column. i.width do.
                count =. (<radius_index,row,column){cells
                if. (100*count)<minimum*denominator do.
                    continue.
                end.
                candidate_count =. candidate_count+1
                peak =. 1
                for_dr. _2 _1 0 1 2 do.
                    if. -.peak do.
                        break.
                    end.
                    other_radius =. radius_index+dr
                    if. (other_radius<0)+.other_radius>:radius_count do.
                        continue.
                    end.
                    for_dy. _2 _1 0 1 2 do.
                        if. -.peak do.
                            break.
                        end.
                        ny =. row+dy
                        if. (ny<0)+.ny>:height do.
                            continue.
                        end.
                        for_dx. _2 _1 0 1 2 do.
                            nx =. column+dx
                            if. (nx<0)+.nx>:width do.
                                continue.
                            end.
                            if. (dr=0)*.(dy=0)*.dx=0 do.
                                continue.
                            end.
                            other =. (<other_radius,ny,nx){cells
                            left =. count*other_radius{sizes
                            right =. other*denominator
                            earlier =. other_radius<radius_index
                            if. other_radius=radius_index do.
                                earlier =. (ny<row)+.(ny=row)*.nx<column
                            end.
                            if. (left<right)+.(left=right)*.earlier do.
                                peak =. 0
                                break.
                            end.
                        end.
                    end.
                end.
                if. peak do.
                    peaks =. peaks,(low+radius_index),column,row,count,denominator
                end.
            end.
        end.
    end.
    (<candidate_count),<peaks
)
line_votes =: 3 : 0
    'edges trig step low high' =. y

        radials =. (trig +/ . * point)intdiv 16384*step
        for_angle. i.180 do.
            column =. (angle{radials)-low
            position =. <angle,column
            votes =. (1+position{votes)position}votes

    votes

line_peaks =: 3 : 0
    'votes low threshold' =. y
    width =. 1{$votes
    peaks =. 0 3$0x
    for_angle. i.180 do.
        for_column. i.width do.
            count =. (<angle,column){votes
            if. count<threshold do.
                continue.
            end.
            peak =. 1
            for_dt. _2 _1 0 1 2 do.
                if. -.peak do.
                    break.
                end.
                other_angle =. angle+dt
                if. (other_angle<0)+.other_angle>:180 do.
                    continue.
                end.
                for_dr. _2 _1 0 1 2 do.
                    other_column =. column+dr
                    if. (other_column<0)+.other_column>:width do.
                        continue.
                    end.
                    if. (dt=0)*.dr=0 do.
                        continue.
                    end.
                    other =. (<other_angle,other_column){votes
                    earlier =. (other_angle<angle)+.(other_angle=angle)*.other_column<column
                    if. (other>count)+.(other=count)*.earlier do.
                        peak =. 0
                        break.
                    end.
                end.
            end.
            if. peak do.
                peaks =. peaks,angle,(low+column),count
            end.
        end.
    end.
    peaks
)

bresenham =: 4 : 0
    'column row' =. x
    'last_column last_row' =. y
    dx =. |last_column-column
    dy =. -|last_row-row
    sx =. _1
    sy =. _1

        sx =. 1
    end.
    if. row<last_row do.
        sy =. 1

    error =. dx+dy

        result =. result,column,row

            break.
        end.
        doubled =. 2*error

            error =. error+dy

    values =. y

            middle =. count<.start+span

                    groups =. groups,<current

make_junctions =: 3 : 0
    SegmentCount =: #Segments

    JunctionKeys =: i.0
    Graph =: SegmentCount$<i.0
    for_first. i.0>.SegmentCount-1 do.
        for_second. (first+1)+i.SegmentCount-(first+1) do.
            a =. first{::Segments

            da =. (1{::a)-0{::a

                point =. point,numerator nearest denominator

            end_a =. a end_choice point
            end_b =. b end_choice point
            if. ((1{end_a)>JunctionDistance)+.(1{end_b)>JunctionDistance do.
